> **Superseded by D-22.** This note was written during the 2026-09-01T06:29Z JSONL wave, which mis-numbered a decision that collided with an existing id. That event is void. The authoritative record is D-22.

## Decision

doc/specs/README.md (id C-GROUNDWORK) stays the single spec root. C-ARTIFACT, C-TRACEABILITY, C-TOKEN-ECONOMY and C-VERIFICATION are repointed from parent:null to parent:C-GROUNDWORK, and a lint rule then enforces exactly one root, a resolvable parent on every non-root concept, and an id on every concept index.md.

## Rationale

Verified in source: README.md declares id C-GROUNDWORK type concept parent null; motive-dag, orchestration and enforcement declare parent C-GROUNDWORK; artifact, C-TRACEABILITY, token-economy and verification declare parent null. Two competing root conventions coexist and spec lint exits clean over both, so the invariant is unenforced. Prose cannot hold this; the rule must be mechanical.

## Alternatives Considered

- Make C-GROUNDWORK a concept dir with an index.md and demote README.md to prose
- Accept multiple roots and lint only for resolvable parents
